sections.title: What we process
sections.body: Account data from our identity provider Auth0 (email address, name, profile picture), the profile you enter (display name, username, country, self-reported handicap index), and the golf data you create: crews, rounds, tournaments and scores. We never see or store your password.

sections.title: Why
sections.body: To provide ROUND9: show your rounds and scores to the players and crews you choose, and to keep your account secure. Legal basis: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

sections.title: Processors
sections.body: Authentication by Auth0 (Okta Inc.). Hosting: [hosting provider, region]. Database: [database provider, region].

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: ROUND9 only uses strictly necessary cookies: an encrypted session cookie that keeps you signed in, a short-lived cookie that secures the login flow, and a cookie that remembers your language. We use no analytics or advertising cookies, so there is nothing to opt in or out of.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can access, correct and delete your data. Deleting your account in Settings removes your ROUND9 profile, crews you own, rounds you created and your scores. Contact [privacy contact email] for any other request. You may lodge a complaint with your data protection authority.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: ROUND9 helps golfers organize private rounds, crews and tournaments. It is currently offered free of charge. Proposed paid plans are not available.

sections.title: Handicaps and results
sections.body: Handicap indexes are entered by users and are not verified. Playing handicaps and results calculated by ROUND9 are for friendly competition only and are not official results of any golf association.

sections.title: Your content
sections.body: You are responsible for the content you add, including course data. Do not invite people who have not agreed to receive an invitation.
